say:1:1130306001:1.text: Slow? They wouldn't dare slow us down. They know the consequences of that!
say:1:1130306001:1.source_cn: 慢？我想这些家伙一点都不敢怠慢，它们知道那会是什么下场！
say:1:1130306001:1.male: Slow? They wouldn't dare slow us down. They know the consequences of that!
say:1:1130306001:1.female: Slow? They wouldn't dare slow us down. They know the consequences of that!

say:2:1130306002:1.text: They're useless if you don't push them.
say:2:1130306002:1.source_cn: 不好好干活的话就它们没用了。
say:2:1130306002:1.male: They're useless if you don't push them.
say:2:1130306002:1.female: They're useless if you don't push them.

say:3:1130306003:1.text: And there's only one use for lazy beasts! More food for our larders!
say:3:1130306003:1.source_cn: 没用的钢鳄兽下场只有一个！那就是被我们杀了吃掉！
say:3:1130306003:1.male: And there's only one use for lazy beasts! More food for our larders!
say:3:1130306003:1.female: And there's only one use for lazy beasts! More food for our larders!

say:4:1130306004:1.text: So eat up and get back to work!
